values.note: $5 per night per additional vehicle (first 2 vehicles free); a second camping unit in a site is charged double occupancy. Cash or check at the self-serve station, or Scan and Pay in the Recreation.gov app where available.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/spillway-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'Additional Vehicle: $5 per night'; updated Sept 1, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250684 (notices) + /rates (2026 First-come, First-served Season WalkInScanPay 15), read 2026-10-22

values.note: First-come, first-served only: arrive to claim a site; the site must be occupied the first night and not left unattended over 24 hours. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/spillway-campground (Reservations 'First come-first served.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250684 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only', 'Camping stay limit is 16 days.', 'Site must be occupied the first night.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The Forest Service page says 13 campsites; recreation.gov says 12 (twice). Some sites along the shore, some back on the hillside; no overflow parking; park only on the site spurs.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/spillway-campground ('13 campsites', 'The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 22 feet.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250684 ('Spillway campground has 12 campsites suitable for tents, trailers, and RVs', 'There is no overflow parking'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: One hand-pump water source (peak season); bear-resistant food storage lockers; no garbage service.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/spillway-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.', 'There is no garbage service') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250684 ('One water pump and two double vault restrooms'; amenities 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Drinking Water (peak season)', 'Food Storage Locker'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open annually late May through hunting season, weather dependent' (and, under Operational Hours, 'Open year round- weather dependent'); recreation.gov: 'accessible late May through mid-November, depending on weather conditions.'

note: In lodgepole timber on the NW shore of the 500-acre East Fork Reservoir, Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Pintler RD), ~18 mi SW of Philipsburg off the East Fork Road (FR/County Rd 672), near the Anaconda-Pintler Wilderness trailheads. A 22-ft trailer limit fits a 23-ft motorhome; larger rigs tight. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Sept 1, 2026) + recreation.gov: confirmed $15 FCFS-only, 22-ft max trailer, vault toilets, hand-pump water; added $5 extra-vehicle fee, 16-day stay limit, season note (late May through hunting season / mid-November). Site count 13 (FS) vs 12 (rec.gov) noted, count left. Hookups not stated (derived none left). Note trimmed of restated values.
